sections.heading: Progress and availability
sections.body:
The game uses local saves and offers no player account, account-based backup or cloud-save recovery. Deleting app data or changing devices can cause progress to be lost. Unfinished casual and challenge boards can be continued from the home screen. Analytics events are not a saved-game backup and cannot restore your progress.

Core puzzles can be played offline. Ads and ad-based rewards depend on network access and ad availability. Updates may change features or compatibility. We do not promise permanent availability or an error-free experience.

sections.heading: Advertising and rewards
sections.body:
The Android game uses Google AdMob for rewarded and interstitial ads. Rewarded ads are optional offers for benefits such as a hint, an extra life or extra challenge time. Rewards depend on completing the advertised requirements and the game receiving a successful reward confirmation. An unavailable, interrupted or failed ad may not grant a reward.

Interstitial ads may appear between eligible casual or challenge levels. Third-party ads and external destinations are provided under their providers' terms and policies. Choosing a rewarded ad does not itself give consent to unrelated tracking or personalized advertising.

sections.body: The current version contains no in-app purchases or subscriptions. Downloads and any store transactions are subject to the store's own terms and applicable consumer rights. Any future paid features will explain their conditions before use. Google and GameAnalytics provide the advertising and analytics services described in the Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: Privacy
sections.body: Read the complete Privacy Policy and these Terms of Use before choosing Accept. Your explicit saved acceptance controls game entry and the ordinary Firebase Analytics/GA4, GameAnalytics and Crashlytics Java/NDK processing disclosed in the policy, subject to the applicable age and technical checks. Reading, Back, closing the app or continuing from an old version does not create the new acceptance. Advertising choices remain separate and follow Google UMP; Accept does not grant personalized advertising or every advertising purpose.

sections.heading: Responsibility and your rights
sections.body: Use the game with reasonable care and take breaks as needed. To the extent permitted by applicable law, the game is provided as available without additional warranties. sections.heading: Stopping use, updates and contact
sections.body:
You may stop using the game at any time and remove it and its local data. This does not automatically delete information already sent to Google or GameAnalytics; see the Privacy Policy for requests and limitations.

Revised terms will carry a new update date; material changes will be brought to your attention where required. Applicable mandatory law and your available legal remedies remain unaffected. Contact Monsoon Isle at aquark314@gmail.com for game support or questions about these terms.
